statement: R-130 advances A13 without closing it. After exhaustive current recombination, the exact R-082 Xi coordinate supplies one fixed-filtration common-terminal Doob and matching once-owned trace recode, but it does not transport arbitrary legacy root blocks or give matching energy without zero conditional fresh mean and covariance matching. The R-123 action owner has a canonical finite-cylinder physical-response-before-pullback construction; exact kernel fixtures keep the 9I/10 source cost separate, while a uniform A1 production response remains open. The fixed six-row Gram has pointwise envelopes L6=1143/(250P) and H6=7083/(500P), with the physical force, Hessian, and Taylor-remainder factors fixed. A scalar zero-layer retires separated floor-uniform rational D2C shelling without refuting the complete Gram cancellation. The sharp balanced bridge has constant one; the local Cartan diagnostic is 0.520915... of the old-budget ceiling, but no global c_bal upper bound follows. A centered-heat direct-low candidate and complete-Gram PSD Schur identity are proved, while rank-one and child-cancellation fixtures rule out an automatic strict gap or childwise refinement. Production C_mix, C_far, complete c_bal, historical R-079 low-owner equivalence, matching energy, a strict low gap, the absolute anchor, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, removals, interacting measure, and Sector-A closure remain open. Tier stays T4.
